components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Blue control action — scarce, compact.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF); color: var(--wt-accent-ink, #0A0F1C); padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary / chrome action on tonal plate.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--wt-text, #f3f5f8); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-line, #fff) 100%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-bg2, #2e3543) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Plate Card
components.description: Quiet glass plate — tonal bg1 on bg0, hairline, tight radius.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--wt-bg1, #222833); color: var(--wt-text, #f3f5f8); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-line, #fff) 100%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--wt-shadow, 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06) inset, 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)); } .ds-plate__label { font: 600 0.6875rem/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wt-text-low, #8a92a1); } .ds-plate__value { margin-top: 4px; font: 600 1.5rem/1.2 "JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Rail Nav Item
components.description: Rail link; active fills Signal Blue solid.
components.html: LiveOverview
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 8px; background: var(--wt-bg1, #222833); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-rail__item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--wt-text-mid, #b8bfcc); font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail__item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-bg2, #2e3543) 90%, transparent); color: var(--wt-text, #f3f5f8); } .ds-rail__item--active { background: var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF); color: var(--wt-accent-ink, #0A0F1C); font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail__item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Metric Readout
components.css: .ds-metric__label { font: 600 0.6875rem/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wt-text-low, #8a92a1); } .ds-metric__value { margin-top: 4px; font: 600 1.875rem/1.15 "JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--wt-ch-tps, #4FB286); } .ds-metric__unit { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--wt-text-low, #8a92a1); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 0.6875rem/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: var(--wt-bg2, #2e3543); color: var(--wt-text-mid, #b8bfcc); } .ds-chip--warn { color: var(--wt-warn, #F5A524); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-warn, #F5A524) 16%, transparent); } .ds-chip--ok { color: var(--wt-ok, #34d399); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-ok, #34d399) 16%, transparent); } .ds-chip--danger { color: var(--wt-danger, #f87171); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-danger, #f87171) 16%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Search / filter field on tonal well.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; color: var(--wt-text-mid, #b8bfcc); } .ds-field__input { background: var(--wt-bg2, #2e3543); color: var(--wt-text, #f3f5f8); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-line, #fff) 100%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF) 55%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wt-accent, #4C8DFF) 22%, transparent); } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: var(--wt-text-low, #8a92a1); }

narrative.overview:
WatchTower’s dashboard is a night-shift ops desk: precise instruments under lantern warmth, Signal Blue for control chrome, and quiet tonal plates instead of loud SaaS glass. The operator arrives under stress (lag, crash, disk pressure); every surface must answer “is it okay?” and “what next?” before it tries to look impressive.

Personality is precise — dense enough to triage, never cluttered for decoration. Form language mixes tight instruments (sharp 2–6px corners, mono metrics, high scanability) with quiet glass (tonal bg0→bg3 layering, soft inset hairlines, restrained hero glow keyed to status — not periwinkle mush or sparkle spam). Brand mark is the lantern / stone tower; display spelling is WatchTower.
keyCharacteristics: Operate-mode density: list+detail inboxes, mission band, Live charts
Signal Blue accent + Lantern Amber brand warmth
Status colours never share hues with instrument channel colours
Three themes: light, dark (default ops), black (OLED)
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion; glow intensity ~0.55 on heroes

rules.name: The Channel ≠ Status Rule
rules.body: Instrument channel colours must not reuse ok/warn/danger hexes.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is control chrome (≤~10% of a screen’s colour mass).

rules.name: The No AI-SaaS Chrome Rule
rules.body: No periwinkle-on-glass clichés, sparkle-as-brand, or decorative purple/indigo defaults.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Live vitals, gauges, and KPI values use JetBrains Mono + tabular nums.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: One inset hairline + one soft drop; glow is for hero status, not every widget.

rules.name: The Tight Corner Rule
rules.body: New cards and controls default to 4px; avoid 12–16px friendly SaaS radii.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue scarce and purposeful (rail active, primary actions, focus).
Do separate channel colours from status colours in every new chart or dial.
Do use Geist for UI copy and JetBrains Mono for comparable numbers.
Do prefer tonal bg steps + hairlines over heavy glass blur stacks.
Do spell the product WatchTower in chrome you touch.
donts: Don't reintroduce periwinkle / purple-indigo AI dashboard palettes.
Don't use large pill radii or multi-layer drop shadows as default card chrome.
Don't put decorative gradients or sparkle text on triage surfaces.
Don't invent a second Skin (Aero/Sass); themes are light / dark / black only.
Don't imply the UI can restart the server, download jars, or auto-clean the world.
